item.title: Redfin defends climate risk transparency after Zillow removes data
item.description: Redfin will continue to display First Street climate risk data on listings, citing buyer value and transparency concerns.

item.title: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac limit public housing data releases
item.description: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac have stopped publishing key housing surveys and forecasts, raising transparency concerns for the mortgage market.

item.title: Louisiana again tops the chart for outbound moves
item.description: Atlas Van Lines’ 2025 migration study shows US mobility remains low due to high housing costs, with Arkansas and Idaho leading inbound moves.

item.title: Luxury home sellers offering more creative concessions
item.description: A survey of The Agency brokers saw more than 60% reporting to have seen more concessions this year compared to 2024.

item.title: Student loan debt is taking a bite out of renters’ credit scores
item.description: The end of student loan forgiveness has led to increased delinquencies, affecting rental applicants' credit scores and financial stability.

item.title: Deephaven Mortgage launches Equity Advantage HELOC
item.description: Deephaven Mortgage introduces a HELOC with flexible qualification for self-employed borrowers, tapping into a growing second-lien market.
